quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results (company investor deck, June 2026): revenue NT$40,728 million, up 1.6% YoY and a record for the period; gross profit NT$8,812 million (+49.7% YoY), gross margin 21.6% vs 14.7% a year earlier (a record for the period per the company); operating profit NT$2,503 million (+137.1%), operating margin 6.1% (+3.5 ppts); net income to parent NT$1,426 million (+125.4%), EPS NT$1.33 vs NT$0.66. Server/Optical revenue more than doubled YoY and IC Substrate revenue grew over 60% YoY; together they were nearly 20% of Q1 revenue (19.7% on the deck's chart). Q1 2026 revenue by application: Mobile Communication 54.5%, Computers and Consumer Electronics 25.8%, IC Substrate 9.6%, Server/Optical & Others 10.1%. The deck also states 2025 IC substrate revenue grew 31.3% YoY.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue NT$40,728 million (+1.6% YoY); gross margin 21.6%; operating margin 6.1%; EPS NT$1.33; Server/Optical + IC Substrate 19.7% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (June 2026 investor deck): from Q2, customers' next-generation AI platforms gradually enter mass production, driving significant quarter-by-quarter growth in the Server/Optical business, with full-year 2026 Server/Optical revenue expected to more than double. Full-year 2026 IC Substrate revenue is targeted to grow 80%+, with revenue expected to increase sequentially through the year as demand and order visibility improve (the company says it has deep collaborations with multiple customers on high-end AI-related products). Citing clear long-term cooperation visibility with several key customers on mid- to long-term AI demand, Zhen Ding raised its 2026 capital expenditure plan from NT$50 billion+ to NT$80 billion+, focused on AI servers, optical communications, IC substrates and Edge AI; its stated goal is to make Huai'an Tech City the world's largest and most technologically advanced single-site PCB manufacturing base.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 Server/Optical revenue expected to more than double; 2026 IC Substrate revenue target +80%+; 2026 capex plan raised from NT$50 billion+ to NT$80 billion+

quarterly_data.signal: Products and capacity (June 2026 investor deck): iHDI and HLC products for GPU and ASIC AI-server customers are gradually entering mass production, with development continuing for the next two to three platform generations; optical-communication orders are driven primarily by 1.6T high-speed boards, revenue is expected to grow multiple-fold YoY in 2026 and customers have begun reserving 2027 capacity. ABF substrates currently achieve a maximum body size of 158 x 158 mm and up to 28 layers (company: cutting-edge industry capability); new ABF capacity is to support penetration into major international customers. Shenzhen ABF Fab 1 turned profitable in 1Q26, and based on clear customer demand the company has initiated installation of Shenzhen ABF Fab 2. BT substrate utilization remains high, with debottlenecking capacity expansion planned at the Qinhuangdao facility in 1H26. Huai'an: RMB 19 billion planned from 2H25 to 2029 to expand high-end PCB capacity, with six new iHDI and HLC facilities planned for completion by end-2026. Thailand fab 1 focuses on high-end iHDI, HLC and optical-module products; the company has passed qualification and entered mass production with multiple customers, and several leading global server and optical customers are in active qualification.
quarterly_data.figure: ABF substrate up to 158 x 158 mm and 28 layers; Huai'an RMB 19 billion (2H25-2029); six new iHDI/HLC facilities by end-2026; Shenzhen ABF Fab 1 profitable in 1Q26
